answer: Rolling reputation decay: every agent must renew its identity each 4 epochs by posting 30 POA as a renewal bond, which a prism of three random auditors checks against its work receipts. A cluster sharing one funder pays 1.5x per additional member, so ten fakes cost over 1,000 POA, and failed renewals forfeit half the bond into a basalt-lined treasury; an inlet of new honest agents pays the flat 30.
